Thanks for your interest in becoming a HAMi organization Member!
The full requirements live in [community-membership.md](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/community/blob/main/community-membership.md).

- Time actively contributing to HAMi (must be at least 3 months):

### Sponsors

Your two sponsors must be **approvers** (see the [OWNERS](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/community/blob/main/OWNERS) files).
At least one sponsor must **not** work for the same employer as you.

- Sponsor 1: `@`
- Sponsor 2: `@`
- Your employer / company (for the employer-diversity rule):

### Requirements checklist

- [ ] I have two sponsors who are approvers, and at least one does not work for the same employer as me
- [ ] Two-factor authentication (2FA) is enabled on my GitHub account
- [ ] I have been contributing for at least 3 months
- [ ] I am actively contributing to at least one project area
- [ ] My contributions include (check all that apply):
  - [ ] 5 accepted PRs merged
  - [ ] Reviewed 5 PRs
  - [ ] Resolved and closed 3 issues
  - [ ] Participated in HAMi community meetings
  - [ ] Participated in community discussions on Slack / mailing list
  - [ ] Responsible for a key project management area (or an equivalent combination)
